asm_staging_directory.description: ASM staging directory path. Required when the ASM option is enabled.

cdb_database.description: Optional: CDB database name for TDE-encrypted containerized databases.

cdb_user.description: Optional: CDB user for TDE-encrypted containerized databases.

connection_type.description: Possible values:`Directly`, `PrivateLink`, `SshTunnel`. `SshTunnel` is used as a value if this parameter is omitted in the request and any of the following parameter's values is specified: `tunnel_host`, `tunnel_port`, `tunnel_user`. Otherwise, `Directly` is used as a value if the parameter is omitted.

enable_asm.description: Default value: `false`. Set to `true` if you're using ASM.

enable_symbolic_links.description: Default value: `false`. Set to `true` if you're using symbolic links.

enable_tde_encryption.description: Default value: `false`. Set to `true` if you're using TDE encryption.

host.description: DB instance host or IP address.

local_wallet_host.description: Optional: The host for the local Oracle Wallet.

local_wallet_user.description: Optional: The user for the local Oracle Wallet.

symbolic_links_mapping.description: Mapping of symbolic links to actual file paths. Required when symbolic links are enabled.

tde_wallet_password.description: TDE wallet password. Required for password based wallet.

tunnel_host.description: SSH host, specify only to connect via an SSH tunnel (do not use a load balancer).

tunnel_port.description: SSH port, specify only to connect via an SSH tunnel.

tunnel_user.description: SSH user, specify only to connect via an SSH tunnel.

update_method.description: The method used to detect new or changed rows. Supported values: - `BINARY_LOG_READER` - Fivetran reads Oracle redo logs to detect modified rows in the source tables. - `TELEPORT` - Fivetran's proprietary replication method that uses compressed snapshots to detect and apply changes.

schema_prefix.title: Destination schema prefix
schema_prefix.description: Destination schema prefix. Prefix for each replicated schema. For example with prefix 'x', source schemas 'foo' and 'bar' get replicated as 'x_foo' and 'x_bar'. The prefix is permanent and cannot be changed after connection creation

password.description: ESM key for the user's password.

user.description: ESM key for the user name.
